$comment: Single source of truth for the SK CORE landing page. Edit this file, then run: npm run build. Product cards, navigation, metadata, sitemap and structured data are all generated from here. Never invent a product URL: leave `href` as null until the real production URL is supplied, and the card renders with a disabled action and a 'destination not configured' note.

site.title: SK CORE — One place for every SK product
site.description: SK CORE is the central entry point for SK products. Browse the catalog and open any product website from one page.
site.tagline: One Place. All Your SK Products.

hero.headline: One Place. All Your SK Products.
hero.subhead: SK CORE is the central page for the SK product family. Pick a product below and you are taken straight to its own website.

about.heading: What SK CORE is
about.body: SK CORE is a directory, not a platform that stores your data: each SK product keeps running as its own independent website, with its own accounts and its own domain. This page only lists them and links to them.
points: One catalog that lists every SK product and where to find it.
Each product stays independently deployed and independently operated.
New products are registered in a single configuration file, so the catalog grows without a redesign.

products.name: SK AUTH
products.description: Account authentication and license-key management for applications, with a sign-in panel and a Discord bot for key operations.

products.name: SK ASSISTANT
products.tagline: Discord bot and server automation services.
products.description: A Discord bot that automates server tasks, with an optional OAuth dashboard published by the bot itself.
